name: Control Test Exception Disposition Check
outcome: Check SOX 404 / ICFR control-test exceptions in three independent runs plus a session receipt: plan an attribute sample from caller-declared policy inputs and a caller-declared population hash (ART-458), reconcile a caller-declared sample and per-item test results into a test conclusion with an exception list (ART-461), then assemble a signed workpaper bundle that records a disposition for each exception, grouped by control (ART-465), closing with a session receipt aggregating the run execution hashes (CRY-05). Each run is an independent recompute from its own declared inputs. The bundle records that a disposition was declared. It does not judge whether a disposition was correct. Population hash is carried between runs as a declared field. It is not cross-verified by any kernel in this chain. This chain is a workpaper completeness check. It is not a severity verdict and not an audit opinion.
